data.narrative:
Seasats is a Series A-stage ocean and maritime technology company founded by Mike Flanigan (CEO), Dan Flanigan, Dylan Rodriguez (CTO), and Max Kramers. The company has raised approximately $40M to date. The comparable universe for this frontier-tech sector is limited, comprising two identified private peers (Bedrock Ocean and Havoc AI) and no direct public comparables.

The valuation analysis applies a stage-progression methodology, treating the $40M in total capital raised as a valuation proxy. Using a standard Series A-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 2.0x yields an implied valuation of $80M. This single applicable method reflects the constraints of valuing pre-revenue or early-revenue frontier technology where traditional multiples-based approaches lack sufficient market data.

The triangulated valuation range is $68M to $92M, with a median of $80M. The relatively narrow band reflects reliance on a single methodological approach rather than convergence across multiple independent techniques. Key uncertainties include the absence of public market benchmarks for ocean technology, limited visibility into peer financing terms, and the nascent state of commercial maritime technology markets. Seasats' valuation is materially dependent on operational milestones, customer traction, and market development in the ocean tech sector, all of which remain forward-looking and difficult to quantify from available data.
